message.content:
Lithium polymer rechargeable batteries are classified under HTSUS 8507.60 as lithium-ion accumulators. The statistical suffixes for 8507.60.00 are:
- 8507.60.0010: cells and batteries of a kind used for the electric motor to propel vehicles of 8703 (the "Lithium-ion batteries" subheading, which also has a vehicle sub-breakout)
- 8507.60.0020: other

Exact suffixes under 8507.60.00 are 10 (used as the primary source of power for electric vehicles of 8703), 20 (other), and possibly a newer revision with other breakouts. A small pouch cell for a transmitter falls under "other," so 8507.60.0020 fits.

{"hts_code": "8507.60.0020", "reason": "A rechargeable lithium polymer pouch cell is a lithium-ion accumulator of heading 8507, subheading 8507.60, and it is not a type used to propel vehicles, so it goes in the 'other' statistical suffix."}
